items.item_text: CA RN and CA NP License- required
BLS Certification from American Heart Association or American Red Cross -required

Become a key member of a world-class health organization and play an essential role in delivering expert cardiovascular care. Take your career to the next level. U can do all this and more at UCLA Health!

In this exciting and rewarding position, you will serve as a Nurse Practitioner within our Electrophysiology team, providing specialized clinical care to patients at UCLA Health's Westwood and Santa Monica hospitals. You will evaluate and manage patients with cardiac arrhythmias, pacemakers, defibrillators, cardiac monitors, and other cardiac devices, while providing patient education and clinical consultation. Working collaboratively with an interdisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, you will assess patient conditions, identify changes in clinical status, and adjust treatment regimens in accordance with established standardized procedures. You will also coordinate patient care, provide patient and family education, participate in interdisciplinary and clinical rounds, facilitate appropriate referrals, document services provided, and promote safe continuity of care. Join our team today!
ACLS and PALS from American Heart Association-required
State of CA NP Furnishing with Schedule II, NPI#, DEA#, Enrollment in PECOS, Enrollment in CURES- required
Document patient care in a concise and comprehensive manner-required
Ability to utilize excel, word and other software programs - required
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative and collaborative working relationships with administrative, clinical and academic personnel-required
Skill in working independently and following through with minimum directions - required
Demonstrate writing skills to compose logical, detailed, and grammatically correct correspondence - required
